concepts.gloss_en: speech (that comes about) by means of truth
the truth illuminating/shining into speech — a process/action, not the speech itself

members.note: representative; adds verb מאיר, describing the act of illumination

notes: Rule 4: an action/state about X is not X. 'מאיר הדבור...' names the process of truth illuminating speech, whereas 'הדבור על ידי האמת' names the speech-via-truth itself. Kept separate.
